If you're having issues with an appliance passing safety checks, I suggest the following responsible actions:

1. Identify the issues: Carefully review the failed safety checks. Understand what requirements the appliance isn't meeting.

2. Seek professional help: Consult with a qualified electrical engineer or technician who can provide guidance on how to rectify the issues.

3. Implement corrections: Based on the professional advice, make the necessary modifications to bring the appliance up to the required safety standards. This may involve repairs, component replacements, or redesigning certain aspects of the appliance.

4. Re-test the appliance: Once
